Who we are

A small team that does the work itself.

The SocialDM was founded by Michael Shad. We work with apartment communities nationwide, more than 7,900 apartment homes, and with medical, real estate, hospitality and enterprise clients who need to be found before they are compared.

LocalLift™, our visibility program for apartment communities, checks how each community shows up on Google Search, Google Maps and AI assistants and reports what changed every week.
